Order Shop···· (August 24)
Order Shop···· (August 22)

Magic Miner 40T
https://heliumdeploy.com/products/magic-miner-40t

Before proceeding, could you please clarify two things?

Shipping date: If I exchange both orders for the Magic Miner 40T, when would you expect them to ship? Would this exchange delay the shipment compared to my current orders?
10% discount code: I noticed that you currently have a 10% discount code available. Would it be possible to apply this discount to the exchange as well, so that I can receive a refund for the price difference?
I would appreciate it if you could confirm the available options, the final price difference, and the expected shipping date before making any changes to my orders.

Thank you for your time and assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Vishal
